overview: This paper proposes a dynamic classifier-free guidance (CFG) framework for text-to-image diffusion models that adaptively selects the optimal CFG scale at each denoising timestep using online feedback from a suite of latent-space evaluators (alignment, visual quality, human preference reward, text rendering, numerical reasoning), employing greedy search with adaptive timestep-conditioned evaluator weighting to generate prompt-specific guidance schedules.

modules.name: Diffusion Model Backbone
modules.description: Implementation of the core diffusion model forward and backward processes, including the noising schedule, noise prediction network, and classifier-free guidance (CFG) mechanism with conditional/unconditional score composition, supporting both latent diffusion models (LDM) and Imagen 3 architectures.

modules.name: Latent Alignment Evaluator
modules.description: Implementation of the noisy latent-space CLIP evaluator for measuring text-image alignment, including the replacement of the pixel-space vision embedding layer with a diffusion-latent-compatible embedding layer, timestep conditioning injection, and contrastive fine-tuning on noisy latents encoded from image-text pairs.

modules.name: Latent Visual Quality Evaluator
modules.description: Implementation of the latent-space discriminator for assessing visual fidelity (real vs. generated), initialized from the latent CLIP vision encoder with a classification head, trained on pairs of real and generated images to predict the probability of an image being real at each timestep.

modules.name: Latent Reward Evaluator
modules.description: Implementation of the human preference reward evaluator, fine-tuned from the alignment evaluator using pairwise comparison labels and the Bradley-Terry model, optimizing the CLIP similarity scores to reflect human aesthetic and overall preference judgments.

modules.name: Capability-Specific Evaluators
modules.description: Implementation of specialized latent evaluators for text rendering (fine-tuned on OCR-score-labeled generated images with an MSE objective and multimodal prediction head) and numerical reasoning (fine-tuned on filtered countable-entity image-text pairs with contrastive objective).

modules.name: Evaluator Training Pipeline
modules.description: Unified training infrastructure for all latent evaluators, including time-weighted loss scheduling (near-zero weight during high-noise phase with linear/exponential ramp-up for fine-grained evaluators), data preparation pipelines per evaluator type, and the fine-tuning loop with cosine learning rate scheduling.

modules.name: Dynamic CFG Search Engine
modules.description: Core greedy search algorithm that, at each denoising timestep, computes conditional and unconditional noise predictions once, then tests a discrete set of candidate CFG scales via the CFG equation, selects the scale maximizing the composite evaluator score, and advances the sample without increasing the number of function evaluations (NFEs).

modules.name: Adaptive Evaluator Weighting
modules.description: Implementation of the timestep-dependent dynamic weighting scheme that computes per-evaluator weights based on score changes across consecutive timesteps, amplifying an evaluator's influence when its signal becomes information-rich, and combining multiple evaluator scores into a single composite optimization target.

modules.name: Data Processing and Prompt Set Management
modules.description: Data loading and preprocessing infrastructure for all benchmark prompt sets (Gecko, GenAI-Bench, MS-COCO, MARIO-eval, GeckoNum), including prompt parsing, category filtering for capability-specific evaluation, and image-text pair preparation for evaluator training.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Implementation of all automatic evaluation metrics used in the paper: Gecko score for fine-grained text alignment, FID for visual fidelity on MS-COCO, CLIP score, OCR-based text rendering accuracy, and counting accuracy for numerical reasoning.

modules.name: Human Evaluation Framework
modules.description: Side-by-side human comparison protocol implementation, including prompt-image pair presentation, rating aggregation with tie handling, win rate computation, and 95% confidence interval statistical significance testing across different evaluation dimensions (overall preference, text rendering, numerical reasoning).

modules.name: Filtering Analysis Module
modules.description: Implementation of the latent evaluator filtering experiments, evaluating evaluator effectiveness by sub-selecting the best seeds from a batch at various denoising completion percentages, comparing latent-space vs. pixel-space evaluator performance with one-step denoising, and measuring information retention across noise levels.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Controlled experiment infrastructure covering: static vs. adaptive evaluator weighting, individual vs. combined evaluators, dynamic vs. mean/median schedules, greedy vs. beam search strategies, and comparison against heuristic schedules (limited interval, annealing) and gradient-based guidance baselines.

modules.name: CFG Schedule Visualization and Analysis
modules.description: Tools for extracting, smoothing, normalizing, and visualizing median dynamic CFG schedules across prompts and evaluator configurations, enabling analysis of schedule shapes, prompt-dependent guidance strength ranking, and correlation with prompt categories (creative, compositional, text rendering, numerical).

modules.name: Computational Efficiency Analysis
modules.description: FLOPs measurement and comparison infrastructure for denoising steps, VAE decoding, latent vs. pixel-space evaluation, and overall sampling cost, quantifying the overhead of dynamic CFG search (~1%) versus pixel-space alternatives (~400%) and beam search variants.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Logging
modules.description: Configuration management for all experiment variants (model family, evaluator combinations, CFG candidate sets, prompt sets), experiment tracking with logging of selected CFG scales per timestep, evaluator scores, and final generation metrics, plus result aggregation for automated table and figure generation.
